Federal Register publication date 1986-03-03 and filing date 1986-02-26 are not effective dates.
notes: EO 12553 (signed 1986-02-25, 51 FR 7237 of 1986-03-03) has one operative sentence (offsets 691-966) ending "are revoked:", followed by a two-column table headed "No. Subject" on PDF pages 9-15; all seven pages belong to EO 12553 and the signature block follows the last row (offset 33109), so no neighbouring document is mixed in. "any amendments thereto" is a general phrase and is not treated as a separate target. The target number occurs once in the held actor text. Target row: 12351 in the "No." column of PDF page 14 (number-only column; subjects print in a separate column in the same order). Subject column cross-check by order: 12351 is the 40th number of the page-14 column and pairs with the 40th subject after joining wrapped lines, "Providing for nuclear cooperation with EURATOM" (offset 29894), consistent with the target's own title. Target original held: jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12351.txt (47 FR 10505, PDF pages 11-11).
producer_d6: EARLIER END HELD (own dated term): the target's sole operative words "I hereby extend the duration of that period to March 10, 1983". Its extension ran to 1983-03-10; EO 12409 (signed 1983-03-07; 48 FR 9829, held official text, offset 1462) separately extends the period to March 10, 1984 and names EO 12351 only as a prior extension, without superseding it. So EO 12351's operative content was exhausted by its own dated term on 1983-03-10 (or overtaken by EO 12409), and EO 12553 is NOT the end: it is only a formal upper bound / clean-up. Later EURATOM orders (EO 12629 etc.) only recite EO 12351. No later event changed EO 12553 itself (no EDGES row targets EO:12553; no held order text amends or revokes it).
